_about: Every tile and creature has a name. Two views draw them. ASCII view: `glyph` in `fg` on `bg`; optional `sprite` ([col,row] on `sprites.sheet`, or an image path). Isometric view: the `iso` block (shape, h, f, color, light, painted) draws a lit placeholder; set `iso.sprite` to an image of any size and it replaces the placeholder (`iso.variants`: a list of images, one picked per tile by position; repeat one to make it more common), anchored at `iso.anchor` (default: bottom centre) on the tile, scaled by `iso.scale`. See web/js/iso.js for details. Talk-box portraits: `creatures.<name>.portrait.image` (any size, fitted to the frame), optional `videos` per state (`thinking`, `speaking`: lists of muted looping clips that take turns), `pixelated` for pixel art, and `frame` colour; a placeholder bust is drawn until an image is set. Animations: `iso.states` and `portrait.states` take a slot per state (`thinking` while Tally works on a reply, `speaking` while the words arrive), each with `frames` (a list of images) or `sheet` + `frame` [w, h] + `count`, and `fps`; see web/js/anim.js. Empty slots fall back to the placeholder animation.

wall.name: obsidian wall
wall.desc: Black volcanic glass, smooth and faintly warm.

floor_glint.name: floor
floor_glint.desc: A fleck of violet light in the glass floor.

archive_shelf.name: archive shelf
archive_shelf.desc: Old log entries, filed away. Cold memory, read on demand.

desk.name: Tally's desk
desk.desc: The ledger lies open. Neat columns, dated entries, a note in the margin about where the map ends.

desk_side.name: Tally's desk
desk_side.desc: The far end of the desk, stacked with loose pages waiting for the ledger.

iso._note: the desk sprite is drawn on the middle tile; with no sprite these draw as the desk box

scribe_desk.name: slanted writing desk
scribe_desk.desc: A tilted desk with a fresh page pinned to it, an inkwell and a candle stub. Finished notes are written up here.

map_table.name: the great map table
map_table.desc: One map covers the whole table: the vault's index and every theme index, with the links between notes drawn in thin ink.

pool.name: still pool
pool.desc: Your reflection, in obsidian. It seems to be taking notes.

graph_node.name: note
graph_node.desc: A point of light hanging at head height. Somewhere, a note links here.

graph_edge.name: link
graph_edge.desc: A thin line of light between two notes.

mat.name: welcome mat
mat.desc: It says WELCOME in letters worn almost smooth.

papers.name: loose pages
papers.desc: Digests and reviews Tally has written for you.

candle.name: reading candle
candle.desc: A tall candle on an iron stand, for reading by. You can step around it.

tally.name: Tally
tally.desc: Tally, keeper of the ledger. A careful cartographer's apprentice.
